evidence: core/catalog.odin:801 — "if b.placement.router_terminal_sep_tiles * b.tile_px < b.snap_radius {" (and line 802: "return {"balance.json", "placement", "router_terminal_sep_tiles * tile_px must be >= snap_radius (the E4 snap-disambiguation floor)}"). core/catalog.odin:1001 — "if i < i64(min(i32)) || i > i64(max(i32)) {" (jint_strict accepts any in-range i32). core/topology.odin:343 — "if i64(d[0])*i64(d[0]) + i64(d[1])*i64(d[1]) < i64(sep)*i64(sep) { return false }"

recommended_fix: Promote the multiply to i64: `if i64(b.placement.router_terminal_sep_tiles) * i64(b.tile_px) < i64(b.snap_radius) {` — matching the i64 discipline already used at core/topology.odin:343.
